title: TRUCK SNAKE
prompt: Create ORIGINAL finished logo artwork for a 1998–2002 PS1/PS2 mascot arcade party game. Follow the supplied Dock Diving image's SIMPLIFIED FACETED PAINTED style, not its layout or truck pose. Thick irregular hand-lettered chunky cartoon letters, exaggerated playful asymmetric proportions, thick ink outline plus cream keyline, angular sculpted bevels with only 3 bold cel-painted color planes. Any trucks must be low-poly toy SEMI TRUCKS, oversized wheels and simple geometric silhouettes. NO photographic materials, NO realistic metal, NO glossy mobile-game look, NO detailed grunge, NO tiny particles. No rectangular badge. True TRANSPARENT background; all lettering and illustration inside generous clear margins. All exact text fully legible, imagery never hides letters. Make a unique composition with sport imagery creatively part of lettering. Text EXACTLY: "TRUCK SNAKE". Design: Lime-green winding SNAKE letters curving like an articulated convoy, a blue cab at lower LEFT with THREE toy cargo trailers curling under the word. The letter S suggests a serpentine road. Compact dynamic curving silhouette, yellow painted accents.
